response.overview: The period of violence in Peru raged from 1980 to 2000. Waged between two guerrilla groups—Sendero Luminoso and the Movimiento Revolucionario Túpac Amaru—and state military forces, it took almost 70,000 lives. From them, 16,000 are still missing and some 6,000 mass graves remain unexcavated. Liminal  shows an extreme close-up of a mass grave. It is the result of following the Peruvian Specialised Forensic Team in the recovery of human remains belonging to two separate cases, both from the year 1984. The scenes were recorded in the Nueva Villa Paraiso village, Huánuco, and in the Tastabamba community, Ayacucho, in November 2018.
response.title: Liminal
